'''April 2002 Kelso tournament''' was a Star Wars CCG local tournament held at The Outpost, Kelso, Washington on 21 April 2002. [[Earl Sessions]] won it. It is known from Tom Potter's tournament report.<ref name="tr-d3605">[https://www.stephenskilton.com/decktech_archives/reports/2002-04-24-kelso-run-the-outpost-4-21-02d3605/ kelso-run-the-outpost-4-21-02], DeckTech (Tom "Majin" Potter, 24 April 2002). Preservation copy: [https://stevetotheizz0.github.io/decktech_archives/reports/2002-04-24-kelso-run-the-outpost-4-21-02d3605/ GitHub Pages].</ref>

* '''Date:''' 21 April 2002
* '''Site:''' The Outpost, Kelso, Washington
* '''Format:''' [[Premiere - Theed Palace]]
* '''Players:''' 8
* '''Winner:''' [[Earl Sessions]]
